title: CHAPTER 10: PUNJAB CURRENT AFFAIRS AND RECENT DEVELOPMENTS

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Tracks key political developments in Punjab from 2020 through 2024.
Outlines major economic and development highlights within the state.
Details significant awards and achievements related to Punjab.

blocks.content: CHAPTER 10: PUNJAB CURRENT AFFAIRS AND RECENT DEVELOPMENTS

cells: Punjab was the epicenter of the year-long farmers' protest against three Central farm laws; Singhu, Tikri, Ghazipur borders; Central laws repealed November 2021
Captain Amarinder Singh resigned as CM; Charanjit Singh Channi became first Dalit CM of Punjab (Sept 2021)
Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) won 92/117 seats; Bhagwant Mann became CM; Congress 18 seats; SAD 3; BJP 2
Free electricity up to 300 units; school and hospital upgrades; anti-corruption drives; 'Delhi model' applied
Waris Punjab De chief Amritpal Singh led protests; NSA invoked; large-scale police operation; arrested later
Singer and politician Shubhdeep Singh Sidhu (Sidhu Moosewala) murdered May 2022; gang-war and organized crime crackdown in Punjab
Congress performed well in Punjab, winning majority seats; AAP won some; outcome reflected anti-incumbency at state level but voter split
AAP vs BJP dispute; Supreme Court intervention; major national news
Mohali (SAS Nagar) growing as IT hub; BSNL, Infosys, Quark, DLF IT park; expansion of IT companies
HPCL Rajpura refinery (Guru Gobind Singh Refinery at Bathinda) :11.25 MMTPA capacity; joint venture; significant for Punjab energy
Ludhiana Multimodal Logistics Hub; Integrated Freight Complex being developed
Punjab targeting 4,000+ MW renewable energy; solar parks in Malwa region
Stubble burning remains a major environmental challenge; drones monitoring; strict action on burning
Punjab declared 'water stressed'; overexploitation for paddy irrigation; micro-irrigation promotion
Opioid and synthetic drug abuse a major social crisis in Punjab; Aam Aadmi Clinics provide free treatment; 'De-addiction centers' expanded
Invest Punjab summit; various MoUs signed; pharma and IT investment focus
